# Kifaf Plot 4

> Kifaf Plot 4 is a residential development in Al Kifaf, a central Dubai district beside Zabeel Park and the Wasl 1 community park, a short walk from Max Metro station. It comprises two high-rise towers of more than forty storeys holding around 1,080 one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, arranged above a shared landscaped podium with a health club, swimming pools, children's play areas and basement parking.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Al Kifaf, Dubai, UAE
- Status: On-Going

## MENASCO Scope

Kifaf Plot 04 is a twin-tower residential development in Al Kifaf, Dubai, marketed as Park Views Residences and set beside the Wasl 1 community park. The 43- and 45-storey towers together offer around 1,080 one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with a landscaped podium, health club and family amenities. MENASCO is delivering the MEP works for the project.
